reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this hotel, and while the hotel itself is certainly good and meets the expected standards, what truly stood out to me was the exceptional service provided by Santu, Teena, and Emanuil.

All three were extremely well-mannered, professional, helpful, and excellent communicators. Their warm attitude and willingness to go the extra mile made my stay genuinely memorable.

In my opinion, people who consistently deliver this level of service deserve to be recognized, promoted, and rewarded with a well-deserved hike. I sincerely hope the management takes note of their dedication and considers them for greater responsibilities.

Santu, Teena, and Emanuil — thank you for making my stay so pleasant. You truly represent the best of hospitality! 👏🌟

Cons  -
Carrot 🥕 halwa was not so good , also that was not hot.

owner_response.text:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you sincerely for taking the time to share such a detailed and encouraging review. We are delighted to know that you had a pleasant stay and that our team made your experience truly memorable. Your kind words about our staff's professionalism, helpfulness, and warm hospitality mean a great deal to our entire team.

We truly appreciate your feedback and will certainly share your appreciation with the team and management.

We also apologize that the carrot halwa did not meet your expectations and was not served at the desired temperature. Your feedback is valuable, and we will take this up with our culinary team to ensure better quality and presentation in the future.

Thank you once again for your kind recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back and providing you with an even better experience.

Warm Regards,
Celestial Multicuisine Restaurant Team
